# Small Group Guided Reading and Phonics Activity Plan
Grade 2 Tier 2 Literacy Station - Sunnyside Elementary School

Lead Teacher: Wendy Pruitt
Paraprofessional: Maria Santoro
Date: 03/12/2026
Group: Blue Jays (4 students)

| Student Name | Current Guided Reading Level | Focus Skill | Target Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Naomi Yamamoto | Level G | Vowel Teams (oa, oe) | boat, toe, road, foam |
| Liam Ortiz | Level G | Vowel Teams (oa, oe) | coat, doe, soap, float |
| Elijah Brooks | Level H | Vowel Teams (oa, oe) | toad, goes, cloak, roast |
| Chloe Campbell | Level G | Vowel Teams (oa, oe) | groan, hoe, oak, soak |

## Schedule and Objectives
- Station Window: 09:45 AM - 10:10 AM (25 minutes)
- Standard: CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RF.2.3.B (Know spelling-sound correspondences for additional common vowel teams)
- Text: The Old Oak Tree (Level G decodable reader)

## Lesson Execution Steps
- Step 1 (3 mins): Review vowel team sound card for oa and oe. Students chorally pronounce the long /o/ sound.
- Step 2 (7 mins): Word building on magnetic boards. Direct students to form each word by blending phonemes aloud before spelling.
- Step 3 (10 mins): Choral and whispered reading of pages 1 through 6 in the text.
- Step 4 (5 mins): Comprehension check and role-play. Maria prompts students to act out the dialogue between Fox and Crow on page 4.

## Teaching Assistant Guidelines
- Provide prompt feedback if a student confuses short /o/ with the oa/oe long vowel pattern.
- Ensure each student practices decoding their specific assigned words from the reference table, including the short /e/ patterns.
- Record anecdotal notes on individual blending accuracy on the daily running record clipboard.

errors.quote: Direct students to form each word by blending phonemes aloud before spelling.
errors.explanation: The step directs students to spell words without specifying which target word list or how many target words to build, omitting the teacher-directed word list required to run the activity.
errors.fix: Direct students to form the 4 target words from their assignment table by blending phonemes aloud before spelling.

errors.explanation: The lesson objective and reference table explicitly focus on the long /o/ vowel teams (oa, oe), not short /e/ patterns.
errors.fix: including the target long /o/ vowel team patterns.
